cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a lightly fired pottery figurine of a human figure standing on a turtle's back, matching the museum's description and attributed to Mopan production; this is a handmade traditional craft object consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: figurine
physical.summary: Figurine; made of pottery; lightly fired and fire-stained; in the form of human standing on back of turtle; turtle has four legs and tail, line incised for mouth, circles incised for eyes, band of geometric design around edge of shell; human figure stands on back of turtle, hands resting on stomach, holes incised for eyes and nose, line incised for mouth.

physical.title: doll
physical.summary: Doll; sewn from cloth; woman made of yellow stuffed cloth; wears white cotton blouse with black embroidery at collar and cuffs, fuchsia skirt with horizontal pleats accented with yellow wavy lines; brown acrylic yarn sewn on for hair, braided down back and tied with multicoloured acrylic yarn; eyelashes, eyes and nose embroidered in black acrylic yarn, lips red, teeth white; wire earrings with green glass beads attached to sides of head.
